### EQ001 — Pure-state quantum Fisher information matrix

*observable*

$$
\mathcal F_{\mu\nu}=2\langle\{G_\mu,G_\nu\}\rangle-4\langle G_\mu\rangle\langle G_\nu\rangle=4\,\mathrm{Re}[\langle G_\mu\psi|G_\nu\psi\rangle-\langle G_\mu\rangle\langle G_\nu\rangle]
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Main equations following Eq. (3); supplement: Supplement Eqs. (S34), (S43)

Numerical form:

```
Apply every sparse generator to the normalized state once, assemble four times the real centered Gram matrix, and symmetrize before diagonalization.
```

Code: `src/optimal_generators/model.py::qfim`


### EQ002 — Optimal generator from the QFIM eigenproblem

*optimization_rule*

$$
\mathbf F\,\mathcal O=\lambda_{\max}\mathcal O,\quad \sum_\mu(\mathcal O^\mu)^2=1,\quad \mathcal G=\sum_\mu\mathcal O^\mu G_\mu
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: equation: Main Eq. (3); supplement: Supplement final paragraphs of Sec. IV.C

Numerical form:

```
Use a symmetric eigensolver in descending order; track signs only for isolated eigenvalues and record projectors for degenerate clusters.
```
